name: fpf
description: First Principles Framework — a thinking amplifier for structured reasoning, system decomposition and decision-making, with applied patterns, forgeplan integration and practical commands. Based on the FPF specification by Anatoly Levenchuk. Use when a decision needs more than an opinion: generating genuine alternatives before choosing one, decomposing a system into bounded contexts, or scoring the evidence instead of asserting it. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
